title: Off Key
description: A timid bass player builds the courage to share his original song with his garage band.

scenes.narration: Marcus played bass in a basement indie band, but he never dared to share the melodies he wrote late at night.
scenes.visual: A young man sitting on an amplifier holding a wooden bass guitar in a garage.

scenes.narration: During rehearsal, their lead guitarist snapped when the tempo dragged, leaving a tense silence across the garage floor.
scenes.visual: An electric guitar resting against a speaker cabinet in a cozy garage studio with instruments.

scenes.narration: Marcus took a leap, plugged in his acoustic, and played the soft opening riff of his hidden ballad.
scenes.visual: A young man sitting down playing an acoustic guitar with focused emotion in warm lighting.

scenes.narration: At first, the drummer kept counting wrong, missing the rhythm and making the song sound disjointed and awkward.
scenes.visual: Close-up of wooden drumsticks striking a cymbal in a softly lit music practice room.

scenes.narration: Marcus slowed his pacing, made eye contact, and guided the band into a shared, rhythmic groove.
scenes.visual: A musician making eye contact with his bandmates while tapping his foot to the beat.

scenes.narration: By the third chorus, the entire garage echoed with a powerful blend of harmonies they built together.
scenes.visual: Three young musicians performing together with passion inside a warm garage illuminated by lamps.

scenes.narration: Taking the lead starts with sharing your sound. Follow along for more relatable daily stories.
scenes.visual: A smiling young bass player holding his instrument strap outdoors in late afternoon sunlight.
